title: Shorter COE renewal terms for existing car owners
asked: Ms Poh Li San asked whether the Acting Minister for Transport will reconsider allowing COE renewals for shorter durations, such as annually or two-yearly, so existing car owners have more affordable options to extend ownership beyond 10 years.
response: Mr Jeffrey Siow said existing car owners are already allowed to renew COEs for five years as a concession, and that shorter renewals would likely amplify the peak and trough of COE cycles, with more owners renewing when prices are high and less supply of new COEs for prospective buyers. He said the ministry will not make this move. On commercial vehicles, he said owners can similarly renew for five years, up to the statutory life of their vehicles, and that the better approach is for them to bid in the same market so the COE is priced accordingly.
